title: [Settings][Tests] Fix flaky MWB IPC test: retry busy test pipe creation

review.body_prefix:
Reviewed the test-only named-pipe creation retry. It catches only `ERROR_PIPE_BUSY`; other creation errors still propagate. All three actual `RunSettingsServerAsync` callers supply explicit 10- or 15-second cancellation deadlines, and the retry delay observes that token, so the proposed indefinite-wait concern does not apply to these callers. `ErrorPipeBusy` is already a named local constant.

No additional correction is requested from this source assessment. This is not a claim of multi-machine Mouse Without Borders validation or unconditional approval; the author's reported repeated IPC runs remain attributed author evidence.
